title: AuditEvent
description: Append-only audit event envelope shared across VEV products (fabric#6, 05 §2 Audit). The envelope carries who did what to which resource, in which tenant, when, and under which correlation id. It never carries a product-domain schema, secrets or customer content: products supply action and resource values, not shape.

eventId.description: Stable unique identifier for this record; the append-only primary key.

tenant.description: The tenant whose isolation boundary the action happened within.

actor.description: Redaction-safe projection of the acting principal. Deliberately carries no claims: audit payloads hold no secrets or provider data by default.

principalId.description: Stable subject identifier (the OIDC 'sub'), not an email.

source.description: Emitting component, e.g. 'atlas' or 'fabric.control-plane', so product and substrate events stitch together.

resource.description: The resource the action targeted. Product supplies the value; Fabric owns the field.

category.description: Data events are ordinary asset changes; Admin and Security events are immutable.

outcome.description: Whether the action succeeded, failed, or was denied by policy.

correlationId.description: Correlates every event emitted while handling one request.

causationId.description: Optional id of the event that caused this one, for causal stitching.

metadata.description: Optional product-supplied context, string-valued and opaque. Must not carry secrets or customer content.
